correctness.rationale: The weighted Euler sequence gives c1=(r+a+b)H and c2=[binom(r,2)+r(a+b)+ab]H^2, so the ratio follows after cancellation. The canonical region is 0<=d=b-a<=r and 1<=a<=r+d; this was independently rechecked from Reid–Tai ages on finite boxes and agrees with the separate published classification. Cauchy–Schwarz gives the upper bound with equality only at all weights one. For the lower bound, the audited derivative in a is nonnegative over the triangle and the boundary derivative in d is strictly positive, forcing the unique corner (2r,3r). The inspected exact verifier independently checks the region and extrema on finite regression ranges; the theorem itself is symbolic.
